items: All-weather Bar Stool Set - 2-piece Adirondack Bar Chairs (W24.4" xD24.4" xH45.67") with 360 lbs weight capacity per chair; 1 piece Adirondack Bar Table(W29.92" xD29.92" xH41.73") with 220 lbs weight capacity.

With Adirondack Bar Table - Featuring a 29.52 × 29.52-inch tabletop, this bar table provides ample space for party essentials like drinks, fruit plates, or tabletop games. Perfect for both indoor and outdoor use, it adds convenience to any setting.

Built-in Footrest - The built-in footrest is 2.56" wide, which allows the person sitting in the chair to relax their feet, and also allows children to step on the pedal and sitting on the adirondack bar chair.

Sturdy and Durable - Made from recyclable HDPE (High-Density Polyethylene), these Adirondack bar chairs withstand sun, wind, and rain without fading. The material is self-repairing, meaning minor deformations bounce back over time.

Quick & Easy Assembly - With clear instructions and necessary hardware provided, every balcony adirondack chair has 8 parts, only need 5 steps according to the manual included, and you will get a Tall Adirondack Chair (Installation tools included).
5-Year Promise - We want our customers to be 100% happy and satisfied with SERWALL balcony adirondack chair set. If you encounter any issues, please feel free to contact us.

Maintenance Free - The SERWALL outdoor bar stools set is low maintenance, it's waterproof and fade-resistant. Requires no painting, staining, waterproofing, or similar maintenance. If it gets dirty, only need to wash with soap, water and soft bristle brush or sanding sponge.

Unobstructed Vision - The unique 28.5" seat height design of our Tall Adirondack Chair 2-piece set ensures your view is no longer obstructed by the railings. Ideal for seating on any scenarios like balcony, pool, porch or outdoor deck.
Wood-like Texture - Based on the love of nature, we adopted a faux wood grain design, which not only maintains the original rustic natural elements of Adirondack but also avoids damage to the forest.
Rain-Ready & Fast-Drying – The slatted HDPE design sheds water quickly, so you can use the stools minutes after a rainstorm. Ideal outdoor furniture for poolside!
